Verification artifacts under docs/operations/ and .certification/ are additive documentation/evidence and do not alter product or test source. IMP links to the frozen implementation commit because the framework provides no routed VERIFY_ONLY execution path (see FRAMEWORK_CERTIFICATION chain).

links.statement: Declared suites: 250 pytest tests in tests/ (pytest.ini testpaths=tests) and 79 vitest tests across 26 files in src/web-app (26 passed / 79 passed in the frozen workspace).

Executions on the pristine local (NTFS, non-cloud) checkout: backend pytest exit 0 (250 passed, 401s), vitest exit 0 (26 files/79 tests, 64s), vite build exit 0 (44s), Playwright preview smoke exit 0 (40s, 'smoke success').

Framework evidence: governed run RUN-A788645E738C4D46 (intent VERIFY_ONLY requested, executed as AUDIT_ONLY), terminal state AUDITED, product_files_modified 0, self-validating receipt (receipt_digest recomputed by the verifier), 29 findings / 6 risks / 3 gaps at 100% category coverage.

Independent verifier process (separate from the executor, and separate from the framework CLI): re-derives the freeze, boundary, runs, receipts and residue from first principles, re-executes the frontend suite and the E2E smoke, and re-checks every gate; it writes VERIFICATION_REPORT.json with a sha256 self-binding.

devagent run --intent VERIFY_ONLY is accepted by the CLI (IntentContract VERIFY_ONLY: terminal_state=INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED, product_mutation_allowed=false, a6_gate_required=true) but cmd_run dispatches every non-mutating intent into the read-only branch whose final else arm hardcodes the AUDIT_ONLY path; the run terminalizes at AUDITED and reports intent=AUDIT_ONLY. Observed identically on candidate v1 (RUN-900A6F47276C4B45) and v2 (RUN-A788645E738C4D46).

The framework's TEST gate cannot execute this project's suites: core/phase4/test_orchestrator.py loads unittest modules matched by a root-level 'test_*.py' glob, while the project contract is pytest with testpaths=tests. A governed mutating run therefore sees zero tests and must fail closed (A6), which the control run confirms.

The CLI supplies a hardcoded e2e_check stub (lambda: (0, 'one-shot: no e2e fixture declared')) which the orchestrator treats as a passing E2E, so no framework E2E_VERIFIED claim can be trusted for this project.

core/phase4/engineering_orchestrator.py performs the INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED and CERTIFIED transitions unconditionally (no verifier invocation, no acceptance check); the real authority (core/autonomy/independent_verifier.py + evidence_authority.py + traceability.py, wired in ValidationCoordinator/factory_runtime) is never reached from devagent run. The framework therefore cannot issue an independent verification receipt for this project.

No framework certification artifact exists for this project: no certificate id, no verifier binding, no source-commit binding. The control run proves a CERTIFIED receipt can be produced without E2E evidence and without any verifier, so a framework CERTIFIED receipt for this project would not be trustworthy.
